latest_cos_commentary.headline: Fusion Connect is a managed UCaaS/SD-WAN communications provider that has sold into hospitality/restaurant accounts for voice and network unification.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: No direct overlap with Genius's core product lines; relevant only as network/communications infrastructure that may sit alongside a Genius POS deployment, not compete with it.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: No restaurant-specific 2026 product launch was identified; recognition in this pass is industry-wide (G2, MSP Today), not restaurant-vertical-specific.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Not a competitive-displacement conversation for POS/payments; relevant only if network/connectivity vendor choice affects a Genius deployment's connectivity requirements.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No named restaurant customers, leadership, pricing, or financial data were confirmed for Fusion Connect's restaurant-vertical business in this pass.
